title: Monthly Service Rates on the Overdue Balance of a Large-Volume Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
A member whose season's buying has passed the programme's volume discount threshold carries a monthly service rate set from that spend and from how the account has been paid, rather than the rate the programme carries.

**Clause.** Where three or more payments have been posted to the account over the 12 statement months before the handling date and the member's input spend on the account over the 10 statement months before the handling date is at or above the programme's volume discount threshold, the monthly service rate is 0.85 percent. Where fewer than three payments have been posted over those twelve months and that spend is at or above the programme's volume discount threshold, the monthly service rate is 1.05 percent. In every other case no substituted monthly service rate applies on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

| Payments posted over the 12 statement months | Input spend over the 10 statement months | Monthly service rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 or more | at or above the programme's volume discount threshold | 0.85 percent |
| fewer than 3 | at or above the programme's volume discount threshold | 1.05 percent |
| any | below that threshold | No substituted rate |

The two windows are not the same: the payments are counted over 12 statement months and the spend is measured over 10.

## The threshold the spend is measured against

| Programme | Volume discount threshold (USD) |
| --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 0 |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 0 |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 75000 |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 0 |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 150000 |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 250000 |
